Annotation Interface Dependency

@Documented @Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(Dependencies.class) public @interface Dependency
Specifies the needed dependency to run the actual project.

  • Required Element Summary

    Required Elements
    Modifier and Type
    Required Element
    Description
    String
    value
    Dependency path format.

  • Optional Element Summary

    Optional Elements
    Modifier and Type
    Optional Element
    Description
    String[]
    condition
    Conditional string to check the dependency need to be downloaded.
    String[]
    exclude
    Exclude needed dependencies using gradle-like path.
    You can use paths without version or only dependency group.
    String
    file
    File name to save dependency information.
    boolean
    inner
    Load the dependency into child ClassLoader or not.
    boolean
    loadOptional
    Load optional dependencies from pom file.
    boolean
    optional
    Ignore this dependency if cannot be loaded.
    String[]
    relocate
    Apply relocations after load this dependency into class loader.
    Repository
    repository
    Repository used for this dependency.
    If you already define a repository with name, you can only configure the name here.
    So, if this repository doesn't work, the dependency will be searched hover the other repositories.
    String[]
    scopes
    Scopes used to include sub dependencies from pom information.
    By default, is used runtime and compile scopes.
    boolean
    snapshot
    Whether this dependency is a snapshot-like version.
    If true will be downloaded the last snapshot.
    String[]
    test
    Test the provided classes, if all classes exist the dependency will be ignored.
    So you can add "!" to make an inverse check for the class name.
    boolean
    transitive
    Load all the needed dependencies defined in pom file.

  • Element Details

    • value

      String value
      Dependency path format.
      Returns:
      gradle-like path.

    • file

      String file
      File name to save dependency information.
      Returns:
      file name.
      Default:
      "ezlib-dependencies.json"

    • repository

      Repository repository
      Repository used for this dependency.
      If you already define a repository with name, you can only configure the name here.
      So, if this repository doesn't work, the dependency will be searched hover the other repositories.
      Returns:
      dependency repository.
      Default:
      @com.saicone.ezlib.Repository

    • inner

      boolean inner
      Load the dependency into child ClassLoader or not.
      Returns:
      true if this is an inner dependency.
      Default:
      false

    • transitive

      boolean transitive
      Load all the needed dependencies defined in pom file.
      Returns:
      true if all sub dependencies will be loaded.
      Default:
      true

    • snapshot

      boolean snapshot
      Whether this dependency is a snapshot-like version.
      If true will be downloaded the last snapshot.
      Returns:
      true is this dependency uses snapshot version.
      Default:
      false

    • loadOptional

      boolean loadOptional
      Load optional dependencies from pom file.
      Returns:
      true if optional sub dependencies will be loaded.
      Default:
      false

    • optional

      boolean optional
      Ignore this dependency if cannot be loaded.
      Returns:
      true if this dependency loading doesn't affect the current program.
      Default:
      false

    • scopes

      String[] scopes
      Scopes used to include sub dependencies from pom information.
      By default, is used runtime and compile scopes.
      Returns:
      an array of scopes names.
      Default:
      {}

    • test

      String[] test
      Test the provided classes, if all classes exist the dependency will be ignored.
      So you can add "!" to make an inverse check for the class name.
      Returns:
      an array containing classes names.
      Default:
      {}

    • condition

      String[] condition
      Conditional string to check the dependency need to be downloaded.
      Returns:
      an array of conditions to load the dependency.
      Default:
      {}

    • exclude

      String[] exclude
      Exclude needed dependencies using gradle-like path.
      You can use paths without version or only dependency group.
      Returns:
      an array of gradle-like paths to exclude sub dependencies.
      Default:
      {}

    • relocate

      String[] relocate
      Apply relocations after load this dependency into class loader.
      Returns:
      class pattern relocations as array.
      Default:
      {}
